claims.claim_vi: The source lists the twelve factors with a one-line gloss each: codebase, dependencies, config, backing services, build/release/run, processes, port binding, concurrency, disposability, dev/prod parity, logs, admin processes.

claims.claim_vi: Config is everything likely to vary between deploys and is stored in environment variables, strictly separated from code; dependencies are declared completely and exactly and isolated; the app is self-contained and exports HTTP by binding to a port; processes are disposable; logs are a stream of time-ordered events; admin tasks run as one-off processes.

claims.claim_vi: Toy run: round-robin over two processes, 10 add-to-cart requests; with per-process memory the carts hold 5 and 5; with one shared backing store the cart holds 10.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung ghi chú, mỗi khung bốn quy tắc, theo ba nhóm.
source_deviations: The source lists twelve factors in order; the lesson groups them into three themes (what ships with the app, how it runs, how it lives and dies).
The lesson adds a stateless-process experiment and the limits of the rule set, which the source does not contain.
The twelve-factor text read was the repository's current content at commit 3ad5a5f, not the original 2011 page.
